about: The merge rule of the shared limits file, as cases every writer must pass. One window per case: what the file held, what a fresh reading said, and what the file must hold after the merge. A stored window's changed_at is 1790000000; winner says whose value the result is, so changed_at must stay 1790000000 when it is "stored" and become the writer's now when it is "reading". plimsoll owns this file; other writers keep a byte-identical copy.

cases.name: no stored window: the reading is taken
no reading: the stored window stays
same window: a higher reading wins
same window: a lower reading loses
same window: an equal reading changes nothing
a reset 48 s later, the largest jitter measured, is the same window
a reset 120 s later is still the same window
a reset 121 s later is a newer window, lower or not
a reset 121 s earlier is an older window and never overwrites
a reset 120 s earlier is the same window: a higher reading wins with its own reset
a reading over 100 is held to 100
a negative reading is held to 0
a fractional percentage is kept as it is
